messages:
maria_sales: Quick Q from a fintech prospect — they require EU-only data residency + BYOK for keys. POC ask: can we pin tenant to EU region (eu-west-1) and still have a failover policy that doesn't move data out of EU? also need subprocessor list and a rough pricing delta for Dedicated vs hosted. cc @devon_presales

devon_presales: short answer: yes we support tenant pinning. If they allow failover that stays in EU (multi-eu regions) we can do prefer-eu with eu-only fallback. If they prohibit any cross-border egress at all then Dedicated/Private deployed in EU-only is the only option.

oliver_se: example routing snippet we usually share: ```routing:
  policy: "prefer-eu"
  fallback: "eu-only"  # options: eu-only | deny | global-allow
```

oliver_se: important: fallback=eu-only will return 503 if no eu capacity; fallback=global-allow will route out (cross-border).

maria_sales: ok — customer said zero cross-border except in extreme DR with explicit approval. they want BYOK + 500 rps sustained during POC. can you list ops tasks and timeline?

devon_presales: ops tasks: KMS onboarding, keywrap config, agree CSR/attestation for HSM, schedule cert exchange. timeline: 1-2 weeks for BYOK integration + 1-week POC prep. I'll confirm exact lead times with akash_ops. Pricing: Dedicated EU-only with BYOK is ~ +35-45% over hosted baseline on monthly commit (ballpark). I'll pull a formal quote from finance.

annie_security: For questionnaire: we'll need to provide the subprocessor CSV + data flow diagram and an explicit statement: "no cross-border processing unless customer-authorized failover." Our subproc list for EU POCs: AWS (eu-west-1), GCP (europe-west), Datadog-eu (monitoring), Sentry-eu (errors). I'll attach the formal export.

akash_ops: Ops notes: to guarantee no cross-border egress we must disable global fallbacks and run Dedicated or Private in the requested EU regions. For 500 rps sustained I'd recommend Dedicated with capacity buffer (2x) or a small pool on Dedicated; we'll size GPUs/replicas after we get the latency profile. BYOK requires KMS creds exchange and HSM attestation — schedule a secure call for key transfer. Expect ~5 business days of infra ops time for onboarding.

maria_sales: can someone prepare a 1-page summary of options (hosted w/ prefer-eu, hosted w/ eu-only fallback, Dedicated EU-only + BYOK) with quick pros/cons and price ranges so I can send to the customer?

devon_presales: I'll draft the one-pager (includes routing snippet + SLA impact + scale reqs). ETA: EOD tomorrow. @annie_security please paste the subproc export here so I can link it.

annie_security: subprocs export: https://internal.redwood/subprocs/eu_subprocs.csv :lock:  (contains vendor contact + SOC/ISO statuses)

deploy-bot: presales-ticket created: PS-4721 — EU-BYOK-POC, owners: devon_presales, akash_ops — https://jira.redwood/PS-4721

maria_sales: perfect. also need a short note on pricing delta for Dedicated monthly commit + any one-time onboarding fees. devon will you capture finance?

devon_presales: yup — I'll request a formal quote from finance and add it to the one-pager. rough numbers: Dedicated EU-only commit + BYOK onboarding one-time ~ USD 8k-12k (depending on size) + monthly commit uplift ~ +35-45% on baseline. will firm up.

akash_ops: scheduling note: we can run a 2hr pinned-tenant test window next Wed 09:00-11:00 CET for the POC. Need customer confirmation and a load profile. We'll provide load generator config.

maria_sales: I'll loop in the customer, attach the security questionnaire, and ask to confirm the test window and the 500 rps profile. thanks all :thumbsup:
